narr: A similar pattern to the 5th brought high plains convection into northwest Oklahoma by early on the 7th, with storms strengthening across central Oklahoma, producing isolated wind gusts over 80 mph and a few large hail reports.
ev: Heavy ponding on roads and ditches overflowing.
